title: ABaC:us — Austrian Baroque Corpus
institution: Austrian Academy of Sciences (ÖAW), Austrian Centre for Digital Humanities and Cultural Heritage (ACDH-CH)
notes: Digital corpus of German baroque literary texts (c. 1650-1750), focused on devotional literature around death preparation (Ars moriendi, Totentanz, Memento mori) connected with Abraham a Sancta Clara (1644-1709), e.g. Mercks Wienn (1680), Grosse Todten Bruderschaft (1681). First-edition principle, XML-TEI P5 with linguistic annotation (tokenisation, PoS tagging, lemmatisation) and person/place indices. Project directed by Claudia Resch and Ulrike Czeitschner; online since 2015, new infrastructure launched 2025. Project archive page: https://www.oeaw.ac.at/acdh/research/literary-studies/research/project-archive/abacus. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
